disclosures: Per PA Landlord and Tenant Act 68 P.S. 250.512, the deposit must be returned within 30 days of lease termination or surrender of premises.
Failure to return or provide a written list of damages within 30 days may result in liability for double the deposit amount.
notes: Pennsylvania doubles the penalty if the landlord fails to return the deposit within 30 days.
Deposit cannot exceed two months' rent during the first year of the lease, one month thereafter.
